api_mapping: One pure MatchServicePattern adaptation, constrained to canonical ASCII strings of at most 128 bytes, case-sensitive type names with URI-scheme syntax, and dot-separated names. Empty request components match false. Unsupported URI forms are rejected by the native validator without a Go fallback. The original three-field impact is for one supplied request before and after a pattern change; it provides no token verification, roles, current authorization, global grant inclusion or effects. The 63 matcher tuples include 12 official cases; 16 original impact cases remain separate from the existing 42 APIs and 62 legacy suites.
